supplementalEvidence.purpose: Preserve the failed GitHub interaction and bind the exact-selector repair to a passing focal Simulator execution.

notes: The iOS product now observes native keyboard visibility instead of treating the IME as permanently absent. In portrait, the shared Save action is mounted above the message keyboard and the search field exposes Done so focus can be released without blind gestures.

The focal XCTest selects five exact fixture contacts through observed list geometry, confirms each toggle exposes the selected Remove state, attempts the sixth, proves the sixth still exposes Add while the original five still expose Remove, edits the exact SOS message, verifies the keyboard and shared Save placement, observes one forced repository failure without closing the editor, then retries through the same control and verifies the exact five-contact payload before the editor closes.

This fixture is hermetic. It does not call Supabase, dispatch SOS, send notifications or contact third parties. Existing SB-06 persistence and FLOW-SOS-DISPATCH evidence remain independent and were not repeated.

This closes the previously explicit iOS Simulator limits for 5-to-6 selection, exact message editing, visible save failure and exact retry. It does not claim physical ContactsUI or physical address-book permission behavior, which remains externally unavailable without an iOS device and is separate from shared editor acceptance.
Raw xcresult, logs and host paths remain unversioned. The committed report is a sanitized projection bound to their SHA-256 values; the raw bundle is retained in the authorized local evidence store.

Product SHA 45e5550f repairs the preserved GitHub iOS final-gate failure. It changes the shared SOS landscape/IME layout and iOS XCTest interaction; the new runtime validation is iOS-only, while the affected Android debug, Web/Wasm and iOS x64 compile gates pass on this Product SHA. The exact four-test Simulator focal suite passed together: the search keyboard releases focus before the Message transition, the edited draft remains mounted and above the keyboard across portrait-landscape-portrait, the bounded row helper rejects clipped contact rows while preserving the exact five-contact payload, and the forced first save failure remains inside the open editor. The landscape top bar yields the IME-reduced row while typing and returns when the keyboard is dismissed; product save, selection and retry semantics are unchanged.
